dict.string: MirrorNotes uses the camera to attach a photo to your journal entry.
MirrorNotes reads photos from your library so you can attach them to journal entries.
MirrorNotes saves photos from your journal entries to your photo library.
MirrorNotes uses the microphone so you can dictate journal entries by voice.
MirrorNotes uses on-device speech recognition to transcribe your voice entries without sending audio off your device.
